title: Intellectual disorder
summary: Intellectual disorder demonstrated by significantly subaverage general intellectual functioning AND significant deficits in adaptive functioning, with onset before age 22.

children.criterion: Cognitive inability to participate in standardized testing AND significant adaptive deficits AND onset before age 22
Significantly subaverage general intellectual functioning evidenced by cognitive inability to participate in standardized testing
Significant deficits in current adaptive functioning manifested by dependence upon others for personal needs
Evidence demonstrating disorder began prior to age 22
IQ ≤70 (or 71-75 with verbal/performance IQ ≤70) AND significant deficits in adaptive functioning AND onset before age 22
Full-scale IQ score of 70 or below, or full-scale IQ 71-75 with verbal or performance IQ ≤70, on individually administered standardized test
Significant deficits in adaptive functioning demonstrated by extreme limitation in one, or marked limitation in two, areas of mental functioning
Evidence demonstrating disorder began prior to age 22
